title: Diffusion Policy (Transformer)
executed: Executes the first 5 actions (10 in long-horizon groups), then decides again
key: Encoded observation features (two image features + state + language vector)

stages.label: Observation
stages.detail: Agent-view + wrist images 96×96 (wrist input zeroed) · 8-D state · task instruction

stages.label: Encoding
stages.detail: ResNet18 image encoders · CLIP language vector (768-D projection)

stages.label: Cache lookup
stages.detail: Query the cache with the encoded features

stages.label: Transformer denoiser
stages.detail: 12 layers · 8 heads · width 512 · 4-layer condition encoder

stages.label: Action chunk
stages.detail: 16 × 7-D actions

stages.label: Execute
stages.detail: First 5 actions (10 with long horizon)

title: Fast-WAM (world-action model on the Wan video DiT)
sampler: Shifted flow matching, one action-expert forward per step
executed: Executes the first 5 actions (10 in long-horizon groups), then decides again
key: Fused tokens before the video DiT + state

stages.label: Observation
stages.detail: Two images tiled to 224×448 · 8-D state · task instruction

stages.label: Encoding
stages.detail: Wan VAE image encoding · UMT5 text encoding

stages.label: Cache lookup
stages.detail: Query the cache with the fused tokens before the video DiT

stages.label: Video DiT prefill
stages.detail: The video expert runs once per decision

stages.label: Action DiT (action expert)
stages.detail: Attends to the video prefill and denoises actions iteratively

stages.label: Action chunk
stages.detail: 32 × 7-D actions

stages.label: Execute
stages.detail: First 5 actions (10 with long horizon)

title: Cosmos Policy (Cosmos-Predict2-2B video DiT)
sampler: EDM, 2nd-order Adams-Bashforth solver, σ from 80 down to 4
executed: Executes all 16 actions, then decides again
key: VAE latents of the current observation + state (a cache hit still runs one VAE encode)

stages.label: Observation
stages.detail: Wrist + agent-view images · state · task instruction

stages.label: Encoding
stages.detail: VAE-encoded into 9 latent frames (16×9×28×28) · T5 prompt embedding (precomputed)

stages.label: Cache lookup
stages.detail: Query the cache with the current observation's VAE latents

stages.label: 2B video DiT
stages.detail: Denoises the whole latent sequence; actions are encoded in latent frames

stages.label: Action chunk
stages.detail: 16 × 7-D actions

stages.label: Execute
stages.detail: All 16 actions

title: π0.5 (PaliGemma 3B + action expert, openpi pi05_libero)
sampler: Flow matching, 10 Euler steps (time 1→0), one action-expert forward per step
executed: Executes the first 5 actions, then decides again
key: 256 projected SigLIP image tokens per camera, 4×4 spatial average pool → 16×2048 = 32,768-D per camera, + 8-D state

stages.label: Observation
stages.detail: Agent-view + wrist images 224×224 · task instruction (pi05_libero does not feed the state to the model)

stages.label: Encoding
stages.detail: SigLIP So400m/14, 256 image tokens per camera, projected to 2048-D

stages.label: Cache lookup
stages.detail: Query the cache with the pooled image tokens of both cameras and the state

stages.label: Gemma 2B prefix
stages.detail: Images + instruction through 18 Gemma layers once per decision, keeping per-layer K/V

stages.label: Action expert (Gemma 300M)
stages.detail: 18 layers, attends to the prefix K/V, timestep injected via adaRMSNorm

stages.label: Action chunk
stages.detail: 10 × 32-D actions (LIBERO uses the first 7)

stages.label: Execute
stages.detail: First 5 actions

title: GR00T N1.5 (Eagle 2.5 VLM + DiT action head)
sampler: Flow matching, 4 Euler steps, one DiT forward per step
executed: Executes the first 5 actions, then decides again
key: 256 image tokens per camera from Eagle layer 12, 4×4 spatial average pool → 16×2048 = 32,768-D per camera, + 8-D state

stages.label: Observation
stages.detail: Agent-view + wrist images · state · task instruction

stages.label: Encoding
stages.detail: Eagle 2.5: SigLIP-2 image encoder + Qwen3-1.7B, layer-12 output (2048-D)

stages.label: Cache lookup
stages.detail: Query the cache with the pooled image tokens of both cameras and the state

stages.label: DiT action head
stages.detail: 16 layers alternating cross-attention (to VLM features) and self-attention, timestep via AdaNorm

stages.label: Action chunk
stages.detail: 16 × 32-D actions (LIBERO uses the first 7)

stages.label: Execute
stages.detail: First 5 actions
